project.title: The Message - Silent Proof v001
project.source_text: An empty industrial cafe waits in daylight. Andre sits beside the window and lowers his gaze. A closed white angular envelope rests on the wooden table. Andre raises his gaze toward the window. From the counter side, he sits quietly. In the wide room, he gives one slight nod.

style_bible.look: Naturalistic live-action photography with restrained contrast

lighting_default.key: daylight from the black-framed windows on camera right

camera_rules: Locked tripod. One continuous shot. No zoom or cut inside the shot.
style_bible.negative_prompt: No subtitles, captions, logos, dialogue or added people.

characters.name: Andre
characters.appearance: Adult man with short brown hair, brown eyes and light stubble; preserve the supplied identity

wardrobe.description: dark charcoal blazer over a plain light-gray crew-neck shirt

locations.name: Industrial cafe
locations.description: Industrial cafe with weathered concrete and exposed brick, black steel window frames, espresso counter, round wooden table, brown leather chairs and green plants

props.name: Closed white angular envelope
props.description: One small closed white angular paper envelope on the table; no readable writing required
